stage: Before the five new A/B development synthesis runs; B training in progress; final text set unopened.
baseline: A standard: original starter with standardized fixed-reference transcript
preferred_candidate_point_estimate_requi: All 45 development texts and both seeds must have attempted records; never select from a conveniently incomplete run.
Overall micro WER is strictly lower than A standard.
Short-group micro WER is no higher than A standard.
Long-group micro WER is no higher than A standard.
Output/context-limit rate and exception rate are each no higher than A standard.
If scoring availability differs, report common-success paired and missing-as-deletions sensitivity; do not declare preference when the conclusion depends on excluding failures.
eligible_tie_breaks: Lowest total generation seconds on the same attempted jobs
Standard generation, then prefix removal, then sentence splitting
fallback: If no candidate meets all constraints, retain A standard as the provisional default and report the observed tradeoffs or negative results.
uncertainty: These are conservative development point-estimate selection constraints, not a statistical non-inferiority test or a guarantee of unchanged short-text quality. Report text-cluster paired confidence intervals and seed-specific outcomes.
training_checkpoint: Budget endpoint is the primary B checkpoint. Any best-validation checkpoint is a separately labeled secondary experiment with actual consumed tokens, never substituted silently.
final_policy: Freeze chosen primary comparison, all checkpoints and generation settings before opening final. Evaluate the six prespecified A/B strategy cells if measured remaining budget permits; selected-versus-A is primary, other contrasts exploratory. Do not retune or reselect on final outcomes.
reference_voice_limit: Identical acoustic reference does not establish equal perceived voice similarity or naturalness. These remain unmeasured without real listening or a separately justified measurement.
split_budget_limit: Report actual segments, summed per-segment generation limits, tokens, added pauses and runtime. Per-segment adaptive budgets do not imply an equal total generation budget to unsplit synthesis.
